correctness.rationale: Conditional independence of excursions and searchers gives a moment M_m(t) for a size-m group; independence of clocks gives the product. Symmetrizing two independent conditional survivals makes the transfer difference nonnegative (both factors Q-Q' and Q^(a-b-1)-Q'^(a-b-1) have the same sign), and similarly gives M_(a+b) >= M_a M_b. Balancing transfers terminate since they decrease the sum of squared sizes. To attain the maximum, transfer from any remaining non-singleton to a largest group (the reverse of a balancing transfer), until only one group can be larger than one. This proves usual stochastic order even for distributions supported on {0,c}, where fixed-K transfers need not be strict. For Brownian–Poisson at any t>0, the no-reset atom gives S_0(t)>0, while one early reset gives S_0(u)S_0(t-u)=S_0(t)-u S_0'(t)+o(u)>S_0(t), on a positive-probability event. Consequently the kernels are strictly positive on an event of positive probability and all other moments are positive. The stated minimal N=4 example and its identity follow by a=3,b=1; N<=3 has no inequivalent sizes at a fixed K. The mean comparison is justified by pointwise order and finite individual Poisson-reset mean, which follows from renewal with success probability exp(-x_0 sqrt(r/D)). At t=0 there is equality; an exact renewal epoch can be treated as the end of the preceding excursion, with S_0(0)=1 for the new one.
residual_risks: The numerical comparisons illustrate strictness and carry no all-time discretization bound. General renewal laws only give weak order; clocks, group memberships and between-reset renewal must obey the stated independence assumptions.

value.rationale: A fixed number of reset controllers is a natural constraint distinct from optimizing the common reset rate. The result identifies the optimal and worst assignments of all N searchers for every K simultaneously across all horizons, and isolates when sharing clocks makes strict differences. The finite controller classification and applied all-time strictness, not the abstract textbook moment inequality or the endpoint special case, provide the value.
residual_risks: The model does not account for costs, competition or adaptively assigned clocks; no implementation benefit is claimed.
